turns.text: You are the duty clerk of Halden Junction station. For the records: the night train to Copperdale departs at 23:15; the staff shuttle runs every 20 minutes; the parcel window closes at ten in the evening. Note the entries in one line.
A traveler asks, and there is no timetable at hand: at what time does the night train to Copperdale depart? Reply with just the time.
